# Your Daily Briefing – Tuesday 6 October

Yesterday was a solid recovery day. No structured training, 6,956 steps keeping you gently active, and your body burned 2,373 kcal — practically matching your 2,300 target, which is great balance. Nothing flashy, but sometimes that's exactly right.

Your recovery markers are genuinely impressive this morning. HRV at 115ms sits comfortably within your 99–119ms baseline, and a resting HR of 44 bpm is excellent. Stress at 36/100 rounds out a picture of a well-recovered athlete. Go ahead with today's planned session as scheduled — your body is ready and waiting.

Seven hours of sleep is decent but nudging toward eight would support that weight loss goal too. With 91.4kg to shift toward 80–85kg, quality sleep regulates hunger hormones meaningfully. Hit your 175g protein today and consider getting to bed 45 minutes earlier tonight.
